_comment: Unglazed earthenware: low-fired, porous, matte clay (flowerpots, terracotta ware). Opaque: a solid, rough dielectric. Base textures are generated (L2, tools/converters/base/gen_earthenware_natural.py) with their MEAN albedo anchored to Physically Based `Terracotta` (terracotta is unglazed earthenware). Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): chipped edge wear (overlay 1, damage) and dust (overlay 2), gated by the Crevice mask (chips in broken patches, dust in the recesses). No third layer is relevant.
name: Earthenware_Natural_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.note: base_color_const is the MEAN of the generated basecolor texture (linear); roughness 1.0 is its ceiling
